sermon.title: No Matter What — February 27, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: No matter the wars, pestilence, persecution or lawlessness, Jesus builds His church and the gates of hell will not prevail. Don’t be troubled; endure, preach the gospel and press in like the Canaanite woman who asked for the crumbs.
